title: Fathom Feature Scorecard
sources: workspace/db/fleet.sqlite read-only (claims, claim events, typed edges, certify tables)
docs/bench/README.md and docs/bench/readings/*, docs/mcp-tools.md, fathom help, docs/intent/scope.md, docs/plans/*.md (1,325 done / 64 open rows), .fathom/observations.md
strengths: verify / done means proven (F-36): 5/5; the one question only the index answers; 1,325 proven rows.
Resolved call graph: find_callers and blast_radius at precision 1.00 against go/types.
Receipts: 50 of 50 re-derived by a stranger's tools; 93% of answers trusted without re-check.
Refactor conservation: six calibration readings pass, including P 0.960 / R 1.000 on API deltas.
An honest bench: pre-registered bars, nulls published, voided runs named.
weaknesses: Payload: fathom's arm still returns 0.86x to 2.66x grep's bytes on lookups; H2-3 never passed.
Governance does not bite yet: the rule reaches the agent, agents break it anyway (M1 fails).
Accurate impact tools go unused: blast_radius 9 calls, rename/safe-delete 2 each.
Beyond Go, call-edge recall is 0.03 (TS) and 0.12 (Python).
Tenancy: the daemon is paused today after a 20.3 GiB wasm spike.

underused.name: blast_radius and the impact verbs
underused.why: Precision 1.00, 0.006 s per query, 9 lifetime calls.
underused.fix: Put their output inside review_diff and the pre-edit hook so the agent never has to ask.

underused.name: Semantic layers
underused.why: 4,025 claims for $27.50, but 0 human verdicts and no per-rule serve or violation count.
underused.fix: Show served / ignored / violated per rule; ask for a one-key verdict when an ignored rule is served.

underused.name: Certifications
underused.why: Stage 0 join rate 94.8%, yet 0 declarations in the live store.
underused.fix: Declare certificates on fathom itself and bind liveness to the commit (O114).

underused.name: Refactor conservation
underused.why: Six passing calibrations; used only on dogfood ranges.
underused.fix: Run conserve in the pre-push gate by default and show its planes in review.

underused.name: Findings loop
underused.why: Tracer passed; 0 findings in the live store.
underused.fix: Arm Review Kit publishing on one real repository.

underused.name: SCIP import
underused.why: Mapping fixed against real clones; 0 SCIP-tier edges live.
underused.fix: Have init run scip-typescript / scip-python when installed.

underused.name: ui-appkit pack
underused.why: Shipped as a pack; never compiled on a consumer.
underused.fix: Compile on app-kit consumers and measure UI rule violations.

underused.name: The agent activity record (call log, hook log)
underused.why: 97,898 MCP calls and 286,758 hook events on disk; today they feed adoption gauges nobody reads.
underused.fix: They are the raw material for U1-U5 (cost per proven row, debt interest, friction map, rule effectiveness, model scorecard): build those views over them.

underused.name: verify ledger and session ledger
underused.why: 17,125 readings and 3,359 token-counted sessions already on disk.
underused.fix: They are the data for N2 burn-up and N3 cost per proven row: render them before building new collectors.

surprises: package_deps is already deleted (surface prune); the roadmap memo still lists it.
doctor probes list_modules, which no longer exists: 338 errors in the call log.
spec_refs fails 170 of 306 edit-hook calls on the old 'sextant' service name.
All 70 guard denials and claim-moment refusals happened inside bench subjects; none in real work.
The prompt hook injected 26 times in real work; 955 of its injections were bench.
semantic_claims already has valid_from/valid_to columns (bi-temporal schema half-built).
0 anchored memories exist in any repo.

features.name: find_symbol
features.what: Finds where a function, type or variable is defined, by exact, then fuzzy name.
features.usage: 3,772 MCP calls (3,695 from agents); the most-used agent tool
features.evidence: Gold source for 25% of bug-fix and 19% of localization answers in scenario runs; a 492-byte hit answered H1-T06 outright.
features.better: Return the implementations and the one-line answer first so the agent stops after the hit instead of chaining references/repo_map.

features.name: references
features.what: Lists every place a name appears across the fleet, with a typed/heuristic tier.
features.usage: 883 calls, 140 errors (free-text queries refused, unreadable stores)
features.evidence: L0 oracle: text mode precision 0.466, exact mode 1.00 / recall 0.997 (SB-45). Gopls 1.00/0.96, Serena 1.00/0.79.
features.better: Default to exact mode; route free-text queries to search automatically instead of refusing them.

features.name: symbol_context
features.what: One call returns a symbol's definition, callers, callees, tests and a snippet.
features.usage: 1,271 calls, 53 errors (25 over-budget refusals, 20 missing args)
features.evidence: Unbounded answers for hub symbols fixed (O90); now budgeted.
features.better: Serve a degraded partial answer instead of an over-budget refusal.

features.name: find_callers
features.what: Lists who calls a function, from resolved (typed) call edges by default.
features.evidence: L0 oracle vs go/types: precision 1.000, recall 1.000 (was 0.607/0.899). Competitor ledger: graphify 0.95/0.93.
features.better: Extend the same resolved tier to TS/Python (file-resolved recall is 0.03/0.12 today).

features.name: find_callees
features.what: Lists what a function calls.
features.evidence: symbol_context already returns callees.
features.better: Fold into symbol_context and remove from the registry (law 4).

features.name: outline
features.what: Lists every symbol in a file, in line order.
features.evidence: H1-T08: every cell spent 5.9 KB outlining docs/usage.md, a doc file, past the answer.
features.better: Budget doc-file outlines to headings only; point doc questions at doc search (N7).

features.name: repo_map
features.what: A budget-bounded map of a service's most connected symbols.
features.evidence: H1-T06: one cell spent 12.2 KB on repo_map after find_symbol had already answered.
features.better: Cut the default budget and mark it orientation-only; or merge into pack_context.

features.name: read_source
features.what: Reads a bounded, line-numbered range of an indexed file (the agent's sed -n).
features.evidence: Added on evidence: H3-1 cost 16 turns / 601k tokens without it. Largest per-tool payload (38 calls, 123 KB in one run); BP-42 fixed envelope over-count.
features.better: Auto-clamp an over-wide range with a note instead of refusing it.

features.name: search
features.what: Grep with a receipt: a literal/regex hit plus the symbol it sits in.
features.evidence: Gold source for 19% of concern-search and 13% of localization answers; added with a pre-registered kill criterion.
features.better: Read its kill criterion on the next lookups run and publish the verdict.

features.name: entrypoints
features.what: Lists likely main functions, HTTP handlers and CLI roots.
features.evidence: No bench reading.
features.better: Fold into repo_map's header; entrypoints become nodes in the system graph.

features.name: list_services / capabilities / server_stats / list_sources
features.what: Meta tools: which services are indexed, which tools are on, daemon stats, a service's source list.
features.usage: list_services 37,155 (most from hooks and verify CLI), capabilities 86, server_stats 288, list_sources 400
features.evidence: Mostly internal plumbing called by hooks and doctor, not by agents.
features.better: Keep list_services; fold capabilities, server_stats and list_sources into one status tool to shrink the surface.

features.name: blast_radius
features.what: Computes the transitive callers and tests a change reaches, with an edge-confidence label.
features.evidence: L0 oracle: precision 1.000, recall 0.983, 0.006 s/query (was 0.086 precision, 10.9 s). Cross-process on the blind route table P 1.00 / R 1.00.
features.better: Accurate and fast but unused: feed it through review_diff and the edit hook, add the co-change oracle.

features.name: rename_impact + safe_delete_check
features.what: Every call site a rename would touch; every remaining referent before a delete.
features.evidence: No bench reading; the refactor plan verb covers the same need with a ratchet.
features.better: One impact verb with kind=rename|delete, or fold into refactor plan; U9's migration tracker counts the same remaining sites.

features.name: test_impact
features.what: Lists Test* functions that reach a symbol through the call graph.
features.evidence: No direct reading; shares the reach engine that tests select uses.
features.better: Rank by coverage evidence when a profile is present (CV-M13 found 3.7% reach slack).

features.name: tests select
features.what: Picks which tests to run for a diff and emits go test invocations.
features.evidence: Replay of 105 commits: recall 0.28 vs a 0.98 bar, time 26.6% vs 25%. Stays advisory.
features.better: Rebuild as certifying-first selection (T4): the minimal set that re-proves every touched certificate, scored against a coverage oracle.

features.name: diff_impact
features.what: Impact of a set of changed files.
features.evidence: review_diff composes the same answer.
features.better: Remove; review_diff is the verb.

features.name: cross_repo_blast_radius
features.what: Blast radius across repositories in the fleet.
features.evidence: Named in vision 15 as unused; service_ref recall 0.20 on real code.
features.better: Delete now; rebuild as system_impact over the system graph's provides/consumes links.

features.name: dep_drift
features.what: Compares dependency versions between two services.
features.evidence: No reading.
features.better: Delete; upgrade impact over a dependency API index replaces it.

features.name: package_deps
features.what: Package dependency listing.
features.usage: 0 calls; already deleted in the surface prune (34 zero-call tools)
features.evidence: Listed in surface_prune_test as removed. The roadmap memo still counts it as existing.
features.better: Already gone; correct the memo and vision 15.

features.name: api_diff (MCP tool)
features.what: Compares the exported API of two services.
features.evidence: The api: delta inside conserve is calibrated (CV-M4: P 0.960, R 1.000 over 50 release pairs); the standalone tool is not used.
features.better: Serve the calibrated delta through conserve and upgrade impact only; drop the tool.

features.name: Cross-repo callers (service_ref, platform-callers)
features.what: Links a client call in one repo to a route handler in another.
features.evidence: VB-31: precision 1.00, recall 0.20 on real corpora (regex route detector, literal URLs only).
features.better: Replace the regex detectors with framework route extractors and contract files.

features.name: http_client_calls / fleet_drift / reachable / traverse / history
features.what: Older graph and fleet analyzers exposed as tools.
features.evidence: Some are used internally by verify; none by an agent.
features.better: Remove from the registry; keep the internal functions that verify needs.

features.name: pack_context
features.what: Packs concern-ranked evidence into a token budget, naming what it dropped.
features.evidence: BP-46 (pack_context vs bare tools) never run; no bench cell called it.
features.better: Run BP-46; if it does not beat bare tools on bytes, merge into query_symbols.

features.name: query_symbols
features.what: Ranked symbols for a topic plus keywords.
features.usage: 2,111 calls (633 from the session hook, 135 from prime)
features.evidence: H1-T06: 6.6 KB responses spent past the answer in two of three cells.
features.better: Shrink default top-N and add an answer-first summary line.

features.name: localize
features.what: Bounded walk from a stack trace, failing test or error to the likely file.
features.evidence: LCA bug localization: 94 vs 93 of 117 at 2x tokens (null); the model never called it (O102). Jev routing lifted its gold-source rate 4.6% to 23.4%.
features.better: Route issue-shaped prompts to it deterministically in the prompt hook, then re-run LCA.

features.name: obligations (tool)
features.what: Returns the rules that govern a file, ranked by scope, with citations.
features.usage: 26,118 calls (22,560 from the edit hook, 1,182 from agents)
features.evidence: Guards pilot 8: rule reached the agent before the edit on 4 of 8 tasks; violations tie control 4 vs 4; clean successes trail 7/11 vs 10/14 at 1.56x tokens. M1 fails.
features.better: Serving the rule is solved; make it bite: turn checkable rules into enforce:true guards and lint output.

features.name: Rules at the edit (edit hook)
features.what: A PostToolUse/PreToolUse hook injects governing rules and findings after or before each edit.
features.usage: 110k real edit events in 14 days; 7,605 injections (6.9%)
features.evidence: Fires reliably with dedup; payload capped. Value measured as above (M1 not yet a win).
features.better: Record served / complied / violated per rule (U4) so ignored rules are rewritten and silent ones pruned.

features.name: Prompt hook
features.what: Before the first edit, resolves paths and symbols named in the prompt and injects their rules.
features.usage: 1,196 events, 1,121 of them bench; 26 real injections
features.evidence: No real-work usage to speak of.
features.better: Wire it in `fathom init` by default and measure first-edit violations with and without it.

features.name: Guards (enforce: true)
features.what: A checkable rule denies a violating edit instead of only advising.
features.usage: 8 denials in 14 days, all inside bench subjects; 4 enforced rules in this repo
features.evidence: ADR-038 shipped; no real-work denial yet.
features.better: Ship more mechanically checkable rules per pack; emit SARIF so reviewers see the same verdicts.

features.name: Layer compiler (compile / compile_layer)
features.what: An LLM distills ADRs, CLAUDE.md and plans into cited, governed claims.
features.usage: 82 compile runs, $27.50 lifetime; 4,025 claims across 15 services
features.evidence: Packs pass precision 1.00 / recall 1.00 on small labeled evals; fleet recompile 2,798 claims for $7.05 (CV-M8).
features.better: Publish per-claim serve counts so compiled claims earn their cost.

features.name: Claim triage (refute / corroborate)
features.what: A human refutes or corroborates a compiled claim with a note.
features.usage: 0 human verdicts ever; 1,843 automated sweep events
features.evidence: No signal exists for rules that learn.
features.better: Ask for a one-key verdict at the moment a rule is served and ignored; that is the signal N8.1 needs.

features.name: Rules to tests (rules gen-test / replay)
features.what: Compiles layer rules into a Go test; replays today's rules over past commits.
features.evidence: Rule replay over 200 commits caught nothing (VB-16): governance stays advisory.
features.better: Replay on repos with real violations (other fleet repos) before judging.

features.name: Findings loop (findings import, findings_near)
features.what: Imports an external review kit's findings and serves open ones beside rules at the edit.
features.usage: 0 external findings in the live store; findings_near 0 calls
features.evidence: Tracer passed end to end (2026-09-18); findings-loop runs r1-r3 lost to instrument faults (O103-O107).
features.better: Arm Review Kit publishing on one real repo so findings actually flow.

features.name: Review verb (review CLI, review_diff)
features.what: One cited verdict for a diff: callers, tests, rules, spec coverage.
features.usage: review 303 CLI calls, review_diff 63 MCP calls
features.evidence: 42 historical PR pairs: recall 14.3% vs a 30% bar, zero false findings.
features.better: Become the change risk receipt (U7): blast radius, certificates, conservation, rules and reviewers, as SARIF/GitHub check.

features.name: arch_conformance / spec_coverage / spec_refs
features.what: Architecture-rule, spec-coverage and spec-reference analyzers.
features.usage: 0 direct MCP calls; spec_refs 306 edit-hook calls, 170 failing on the old 'sextant' service name
features.evidence: Used inside review; spec_refs is silently broken for one repo.
features.better: Keep as internals of review and the architecture drift radar (U11); fix the spec_refs service resolution bug.

features.name: verify / verify_plan (done means proven)
features.what: Checks each claimed plan row against the index and exits nonzero on an unproven claim.
features.usage: 16,890 MCP calls; 17,125 ledger readings; wired into stop hook and pre-push
features.evidence: 1,325 plan rows proven here. The verify-reachability task is the one question only the index answers (every grep arm failed it). False-done reduction (M2) not yet measured.
features.better: Measure M2 on a public corpus with plan-grammar rows so the core claim has a number.

features.name: Plan grammar v2
features.what: Markdown checklist rows with symbol/test/path anchors that make done computable.
features.evidence: The only spec format with anchors; foreign formats are prose.
features.better: Add weight:, accept: (EARS) and tests: fields; read Spec Kit/OpenSpec in place.

features.name: plans status / next / history / leases
features.what: Computed progress, next eligible rows and row history.
features.evidence: Feeds G4/G5/G13 goals as the instrument.
features.better: Burn-up and proof regressions from the existing verify ledger.

features.name: Claim moment (stop hook)
features.what: At session end, flags rows ticked [x] that fail verification.
features.usage: 145 checks, 62 refusals, all in bench subjects
features.evidence: Catches false done in bench runs; no real-work refusal recorded yet.
features.better: Report the refusal rate per agent as claim honesty.

features.name: Receipts (receipt verify)
features.what: Every answer carries a receipt a stranger re-derives with git and go/types alone.
features.evidence: 50 of 50 re-derived; envelope 7.6% of median payload; answers trusted without re-check 93%.
features.better: Extend re-derivation beyond Go.

features.name: Certifications (certify status/gaps/suggest/orphans)
features.what: Links tests to the behaviour they certify and reports targets with no live certificate.
features.usage: 0 certify declarations in the live store; 120 decision-port suggestions
features.evidence: Join rate 94.8% (stage 0 passes); CV-44 read a false ok when the service name was guessed; O114: a certificate stays live through any code change.
features.better: Bind liveness to the commit, fix service resolution, and declare certificates on one real repo.

features.name: Refactor conservation (conserve, refactor plan/status)
features.what: Computes what a refactor must keep (API, certified behaviour, governance) and ratchets removals.
features.evidence: CV-M1, M2 (0% false flags), M4 (P 0.960 / R 1.000), M5, M6, M14 all pass.
features.better: Run it in the pre-push gate on every range; show its plane verdicts in review.

features.name: Execution evidence (tests coverage / tests ingest)
features.what: Per-symbol statement coverage by test layer, joined to changed code.
features.evidence: CV-M14 passes; CV-M13: static reach says 'attested' for 168 functions that never ran (3.7%).
features.better: Ingest lcov/Cobertura/JaCoCo/coverage.py/Istanbul (T3) so coverage exists beyond Go.

features.name: CUE shadows (gen-status-cue, gen-plan-cue)
features.what: Emits CUE mirrors of plans and status for schema checks.
features.evidence: Plumbing under ADR-018.
features.better: Hide as internal; drop from the top-level help.

features.name: Anchored memory (memory, memory_search)
features.what: Notes anchored to symbols or files that expire when the code drifts.
features.usage: 0 memories in any repo; memory_search 2 calls
features.evidence: Excluded from the bench by design; no reading.
features.better: Remove; continuity threads already carry the hand-off. Revisit only with demand.

features.name: Continuity threads (thread note/point/handoff)
features.what: Carries the work across sessions: hand-off notes, pre-compaction pointers, session-end deposits.
features.evidence: G3 bet at 4 of 20 units; M4 (resume without re-discovery) refuted in a run later voided (O41).
features.better: Reach the 20-unit sample and let the flywheel keep or kill it.

features.name: discoveries / routes
features.what: Recent and long-lived discovery pointers, resolved fresh against the index.
features.evidence: Kill criteria still undecided (G11).
features.better: Fold into the session brief; the discovery-not-reused signal becomes an input to the friction map (U3).

features.name: Session brief (session hook, prime)
features.what: One-line identity, freshness and thread brief at session start.
features.evidence: Payload cost tracked per brief; token effect unmeasured.
features.better: Measure first-edit tokens with and without it (G2 A/B).

features.name: Intent audit / doctrine / render
features.what: Checks docs/intent conditions, invariants and goals against the repo.
features.evidence: ADR-027 caught an audit that silently read 0 of 37 invariants. K0 demand signal (3 annotations) unmet.
features.better: Evaluate computable revisit triggers by machine and list decisions due for review (U11).

features.name: Config custodian (config audit / propose)
features.what: Falsifiable concerns about CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md checked against code facts.
features.evidence: VB-29 code-fact classifier precision 0.649 (bar 0.8); anchored-fresh alone 0.96.
features.better: Serve only the anchored-fresh class until the other classes pass.

features.name: doctor
features.what: Deterministic wiring diagnosis: registration, daemon, hooks, stanza, skills.
features.evidence: It calls list_modules, a tool that no longer exists: 338 errors in the call log.
features.better: Fix the list_modules probe; add a timed stranger check (G16).

features.name: Impact metrics (metrics, instrument, flywheel, retro, rate, arm)
features.what: Counterfactual A/B arms, adoption gauges, session ratings, channel health.
features.evidence: G2: 0 admissible A/B units; every savings claim stays inadmissible.
features.better: Collapse the verbs into one metrics verb; the call log and hook log they read become the data for U1-U5 views.

features.name: narrate / brief / research
features.what: Story mode, a shareable value brief, a sanitized research bundle.
features.evidence: No reading.
features.better: Remove; the console and bench readings cover the need.

features.name: Observatory console
features.what: A local web console: fleet, project, plan, evidence, system and learn pages.
features.evidence: UX-M1 fails narrowly: 9 of 10 tasks in 3 clicks or fewer; all 10 answers equal their verb's JSON.
features.better: Add the progress and economics views; fix the plan-row list click depth.

features.name: staleness_report
features.what: Source files, last-ingested state and git drift for a service.
features.evidence: Freshness left positioning: graphify watch answered 4 of 5 post-edit questions (VB-18).
features.better: Add doc drift: flag doc spans whose named symbol changed.

features.name: stale_docs
features.what: Scans docs for references to symbols that no longer exist.
features.evidence: No reading.
features.better: Fold into staleness_report's doc drift.

features.name: Fleet report / reconcile / receipts / undo
features.what: Fleet-wide wiring drift, reversible reconcile with receipts.
features.evidence: Every write receipted and reversible; not run for six weeks.
features.better: Run reconcile from the console on a schedule the user triggers; show drift on the fleet page.

features.name: init / onboard / plugin render
features.what: One-command repo wiring; a plugin tree for Claude Code and Agent Plugins 1.0.
features.evidence: v0.7.0: a fresh clone did not build and adopters were told one machine's launchd label; fixed. RT-182/183 onboarding bugs fixed today.
features.better: Timed stranger check to first proven answer in 5 minutes; publish the plugin.

features.name: Harness port (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor rows)
features.what: Descriptor registry and codecs so hooks, skills and MCP reach many agent clients.
features.usage: Claude Code and Codex verified; others 'unverified on this machine'
features.evidence: Byte-identical Claude Code golden.
features.better: Verify Cursor, Copilot and Gemini hooks live; read every client's rules files.

features.name: Skills pack (fathom-* skills)
features.what: Agent skills for onboard, doctor, verify, plan, findings, custodian.
features.evidence: Rendered for Claude Code and the .agents/skills path.
features.better: Log skill invocations so the call log can judge them.

features.name: Responsible tenant (budget, admission, resources, daemon controls)
features.what: The daemon keeps to a memory budget, refuses what cannot fit with a named reason, and has a kill switch.
features.usage: resources/daemon CLI; 40+ named over-budget refusals in the call log
features.evidence: Waves C-F: footprint under 0.8 GiB on the real fleet. But the daemon is paused today after tree-sitter wasm growth hit 20.3 GiB.
features.better: Ship RT-99 (no inline ingest) and RT-107 (wasm memory cap); read RT-M1's seven days.

features.name: scope suppress / purge
features.what: Reversible suppression of paths; irreversible purge with history.
features.evidence: No reading.
features.better: Surface suppressions on the console system page.

features.name: Ingest and refresh (ingest, watch, post-commit hook)
features.what: Builds and refreshes the index through the daemon, hash-gated.
features.evidence: An ingest that read no file is never recorded complete (F2 fix today).
features.better: Incremental equals full equivalence check before live updates.

features.name: obligations pack
features.what: Default pack: rules from CLAUDE.md, ADRs and plan READMEs.
features.evidence: ADR-016 baseline; stale claims once rendered as binding (O88, fixed).
features.better: Retire rules never served in 90 days.

features.name: adr-rules pack
features.what: Distills accepted ADRs into scoped rules.
features.evidence: Precision 1.00 / recall 1.00 on 7 rules + 2 traps.
features.better: Bi-temporal validity so a superseded ADR's rule has an end date.

features.name: spec-bindings pack
features.what: Binds plan rows and specs to the code they govern.
features.evidence: Precision 1.00 / recall 1.00 on 6 rules + 2 traps.
features.better: Feed foreign spec formats through the same pack.

features.name: ui-appkit pack
features.what: A kit-shipped pack of UI doctrine rules for app-kit consumers.
features.usage: 0 compiled claims in the fleet store
features.evidence: Pack exists in .fathom/layers; never compiled on a consumer.
features.better: Compile it on app-kit and one consumer, then measure UI rule violations.

features.name: Expert modules (module verbs, module_query/obligations/staleness)
features.what: Data-defined expert packs with eval and kill gates, plus a hosted module surface.
features.evidence: Plans proven (expert-suite J, O-R) but no consumer.
features.better: Remove the module MCP tools; keep the pack format that layers already use.

features.name: Decision port (Jev / llm adapters)
features.what: Typed fast model decisions that rank and route, never assert a code fact.
features.usage: 120 rulings, all certify suggest; off by default
features.evidence: Route site fails calibration: 45.7% right at confidence >= 0.9. Obligations re-rank measured net negative; default flipped off.
features.better: Keep to proposals: anchor inference (N4) and task preflight scoring (U6), each only after a passing calibration and an A/B against the deterministic baseline.

features.name: Assess lanes (priced model judge)
features.what: A model judges a unit's on-disk work against typed questions, priced and off by default.
features.evidence: Designed and proven (ADR-046) but never used.
features.better: Freeze and remove from help until an owner pull.

features.name: providers / smoke
features.what: Auth and one-token probes across configured LLM profiles.
features.evidence: Needed for compile.
features.better: Fold into doctor as a row.

features.name: Bench (context, scenario, index, review benches)
features.what: Pre-registered, replicated A/B runs against oracles fathom does not own.
features.usage: 15+ recorded runs; ~$87 next round planned, not run
features.evidence: Honest nulls published (LCA, M1, M4). Level with best lookup tools; payload still 0.86-2.66x grep.
features.better: Run the planned next round; make bench-targeted the per-change loop.

features.name: Typed edges
features.what: Resolved call edges (direct, interface dispatch, func-value, file-resolved).
features.evidence: Go: find_callers P/R 1.00. TS/Python file-resolved: precision 0.87/0.95, recall 0.03/0.12.
features.better: Raise non-Go recall, the biggest single accuracy gap.

features.name: SCIP import
features.what: Imports scip-typescript/scip-python indexes as typed edges.
features.usage: 0 SCIP-tier edges in the live store
features.evidence: O115 fixed; mapping bugs closed against real zod/flask clones.
features.better: Run the SCIP indexer automatically in init when the toolchain is present.

features.name: SCIP export
features.what: Writes symbols and typed edges as a SCIP index.
features.better: Cheap interop; leave as is.

features.name: Language extraction breadth
features.what: Tree-sitter extraction across languages and tool formats.
features.evidence: ADR-048 ladder running.
